decisions.reason: Its demonstrated use by a major public customer and integration with more than 30 government APIS schemes remains well above aspiration for a large expanding security firm, so management would keep it.

Although evidence is still limited, the training module fits the firm's existing training capabilities and customer base, and available organisational slack supports retaining it while results remain uncertain.
The web platform is closely tied to the firm's established airport and document-security activities, so with acceptable strategic fit and no clear performance shortfall management would continue it.
